mismatches_detail.description: MCP wrapper returns {image_id, path, status, note}; lib.rs stub returns {image_id, path, os_type, os_version, arch, physical_memory_size, profiles}. Fields os_type/arch/profiles are absent from MCP response.

Field name mismatch: MCP uses 'plugin' and returns structured rows array; lib.rs uses 'plugin_name' and returns a flat string 'output'. The pslist stub in lib.rs returns textual table; MCP returns empty rows array.
MCP exposes 12 plugins via forensics_list_plugins; neither lib.rs nor the Python validator implements or tests this tool.

notes: All 14 Python validator self-tests pass (hashing, evidence, carving, timeline, malware analysis, memory segments).

forensics.run_plugin with pslist on a non-memory-dump path returns empty rows (row_count=0); lib.rs stub would return a hardcoded text table.
